messages:
Priya (eng-platform): quick check — GuestNet (Helios) private rollout is T-24h. Are NAT/gateway owners set for the egress fallback plan?
Sam (net): I am the NAT owner for Helios. I plan to apply the staging SG change at 09:30 UTC tomorrow, prod at 10:30 if staging smoke is clean.
Jules (platform): heads up — VPN cert rotation window is 11:00-11:20 UTC. Need to avoid that during our cutover. ops-bot scheduled a maintenance note.
Priya (eng-platform): good call. who's owning the air-gap image sync to the customer airlock? last time we had checksum mismatches.
Marta (infra): I'll own image sync and the airlock transfer. using the `airlock-sync.sh` flow + signed checksums. Need approval on the checksum signing key import for Helios.
Vlad (security): confirm: Helios will *not* use KMS access over the airgap. We need manual import of the signing key into their HSM. I'll prepare the key package and procedure.
Sam (net): also — prober and metrics need outbound to our telemetry proxy as fallback (10.8.0.0/16). Can we whitelist that in Helios staging NAT?
Marta (infra): will add whitelist to staging NAT SGs. please post exact subnet and port ranges.
Sam (net): adding below, should be fine:
```
# staging nat egress rules
ip range: 10.8.0.0/16
ports: 443, 123 (ntp)
protocol: tcp/udp
```
Priya (eng-platform): perfect. add that snippet to the rollout doc and the runbook.
Kei (eng-sre): quick ops question — if the egress path fails, do we fallback to a local small model on customer infra or degrade to a lower-QPS hosted fallback? need to know for SLA messaging.
Jules (platform): we have a fallback policy template. prefer local tiny-model if local resources present, else route to hosted fallback (costly). I'll add the policy to the canary config.
Priya (eng-platform): @Jules please add the policy and tag the canary. Also @Marta confirm the image version we ship contains the tiny-model artifact.
Marta (infra): confirmed — image `guestnet-v2.3.1` includes `tiny-model-v0.9`. I will attach the SHA256 in the sync package.
Vlad (security): also double-check the attestation step in the airlock transfer. I'll add a quick checklist item: verify SHA256 + signature before import.
Jules (platform): PR created: #1293 — adds fallback policy + canary tags. pinging for review. :pr: :eyes:
Sam (net): reviewed, left minor comment on SG naming. otherwise LGTM.
Priya (eng-platform): Sam can you merge once the SG name comment is addressed?
Sam (net): merged. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: staging -> prod at 2026-03-20T09:45:00Z. Maint window 30m.
Priya (eng-platform): thanks all. final checklist for tomorrow: 1) Sam apply staging SG whitelist 09:30 2) Marta run airlock sync + checksum import 09:40 3) Jules ensure canary policy active 09:45 4) Kei run smoke prober 09:50. Report back here on smoke.
Kei (eng-sre): I'll run smoke and post results.
Marta (infra): noted — I'll post transfer logs and signature file once done.
Vlad (security): I'll stand by for key import confirmation.
Priya (eng-platform): if anyone hits a blocker, ping @oncall. otherwise we'll proceed. :rocket:
